faqs.q: How do I book at the Ahmedabad clinic?
faqs.a: Call +91 98259 71010 or use the booking form and choose Ahmedabad. The team will confirm the clinic address, consulting days and the next available slot.

faqs.q: Which areas does the Ahmedabad clinic serve?
faqs.a: Patients visit from across Ahmedabad, including East Ahmedabad. Ask the team for directions from your area when you book.

faqs.q: Which treatments are offered in Ahmedabad?
faqs.a: Skin, hair, laser and cosmetic treatments. Please confirm availability of a specific treatment or machine when you call, as the two clinics do not carry identical equipment.
